```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(collapse = TRUE, comment = "#>")
```

The main cohort expression workflow is documented in
`vignette("cohort-expression-core", package = "posteriorHCA")`.

If your counts live in a Seurat or SummarizedExperiment object,
`scale_to_hca_reference()` is a convenience wrapper around
`merge_with_reference_sample()` and `calculate_tmm_offset()`. After scaling,
extract the user count matrix and offsets and continue with ordinary
`model.matrix()` + `estimate_logmu_ql()` as in the main vignette.

Atlas models require Ensembl gene ids. Map symbols to ENSG outside this
package (for example with AnnotationDbi / org.Hs.eg.db) before scaling.
